title: MSCCR_reGRID_1_Biopsy_1, UC participants,Rectum NonI tissue
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was isolated from frozen tissue using Qiagen QIAsymphony RNA Kit (cat.# 931636) on the QIAsymphony.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Preparation of the sequencing libraries used the RNA Tru Seq Kit (Illumina (Cat # RS-122-2001-48)
data_processing: Genomic alignment to GRCh37 of single-end RNA-seq reads was performed using 2-pass STAR. Default parameters for STAR were used, as were those for the quantification of aligned reads to GRCh37.75 gene features via featureCounts. Multimapping reads were flagged and discarded
data_processing.1: Raw count data was pre-filtered to keep genes with CPM>0.5 for at least 3% of the samples
data_processing.2: After filtering, count data was normalized via the weighted trimmed mean of M-values
data_processing.3: Gene expression matrices were generated using the voom transformation and adjusted for technical variables (e.g. RIN, processing batch, rRNA rate and exonic rate) using the limma framework
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every sample

extract_protocol_ch1.1: Preparation of the sequencing libraries used the RNA Tru Seq Kit (Illumina (Cat # RS-122-2001-48)
data_processing: Genomic alignment to GRCh37 of single-end RNA-seq reads was performed using 2-pass STAR. Default parameters for STAR were used, as were those for the quantification of aligned reads to GRCh37.75 gene features via featureCounts. Multimapping reads were flagged and discarded
data_processing.1: Raw count data was pre-filtered to keep genes with CPM>0.5 for at least 3% of the samples
data_processing.2: After filtering, count data was normalized via the weighted trimmed mean of M-values
data_processing.3: Gene expression matrices were generated using the voom transformation and adjusted for technical variables (e.g. RIN, processing batch, rRNA rate and exonic rate) using the limma framework
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every sample

extract_protocol_ch1.1: Preparation of the sequencing libraries used the RNA Tru Seq Kit (Illumina (Cat # RS-122-2001-48)
data_processing: Genomic alignment to GRCh37 of single-end RNA-seq reads was performed using 2-pass STAR. Default parameters for STAR were used, as were those for the quantification of aligned reads to GRCh37.75 gene features via featureCounts. Multimapping reads were flagged and discarded
data_processing.1: Raw count data was pre-filtered to keep genes with CPM>0.5 for at least 3% of the samples
data_processing.2: After filtering, count data was normalized via the weighted trimmed mean of M-values
data_processing.3: Gene expression matrices were generated using the voom transformation and adjusted for technical variables (e.g. RIN, processing batch, rRNA rate and exonic rate) using the limma framework
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every sample

extract_protocol_ch1.1: Preparation of the sequencing libraries used the RNA Tru Seq Kit (Illumina (Cat # RS-122-2001-48)
data_processing: Genomic alignment to GRCh37 of single-end RNA-seq reads was performed using 2-pass STAR. Default parameters for STAR were used, as were those for the quantification of aligned reads to GRCh37.75 gene features via featureCounts. Multimapping reads were flagged and discarded
data_processing.1: Raw count data was pre-filtered to keep genes with CPM>0.5 for at least 3% of the samples
data_processing.2: After filtering, count data was normalized via the weighted trimmed mean of M-values
data_processing.3: Gene expression matrices were generated using the voom transformation and adjusted for technical variables (e.g. RIN, processing batch, rRNA rate and exonic rate) using the limma framework
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every sample

extract_protocol_ch1.1: Preparation of the sequencing libraries used the RNA Tru Seq Kit (Illumina (Cat # RS-122-2001-48)
data_processing: Genomic alignment to GRCh37 of single-end RNA-seq reads was performed using 2-pass STAR. Default parameters for STAR were used, as were those for the quantification of aligned reads to GRCh37.75 gene features via featureCounts. Multimapping reads were flagged and discarded
data_processing.1: Raw count data was pre-filtered to keep genes with CPM>0.5 for at least 3% of the samples
data_processing.2: After filtering, count data was normalized via the weighted trimmed mean of M-values
data_processing.3: Gene expression matrices were generated using the voom transformation and adjusted for technical variables (e.g. RIN, processing batch, rRNA rate and exonic rate) using the limma framework
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every sample
